summary: PRDocuments is an ASP.NET UserControl for managing Placement Request documents in the HSPnet system. It exposes a UI for listing, uploading, editing, and deleting documents associated with placement requests, with strict workflows for validating and storing uploaded files, and business rules for document types.
purpose: To facilitate the upload, management, and association of documents with Placement Requests, enforcing organization rules and ensuring proper categorization, validation, and storage of document files.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.purpose: Server filesystem path to document file

actors: System (Handles file storage, validation, session management)

workflows.name: Document List and Edit
steps: User sees a list of documents in GridView.
User clicks edit: switches FormView to edit mode.
If document does not exist, FormView is bound to new PlacementRequestDocument instance.
If document exists, FormView is bound to PlacementRequestDocument fetched by ID.
Document details are shown in modal popup.

workflows.name: Upload and Save Document
steps: User uploads file with FileUpload control.
System validates file (not empty, proper type).
System renames file, creates unique folder, saves file to filesystem.
File path and URL are generated and stored.
Document metadata (type, comments, file info) is captured.
Previous file (if any) is deleted as cleanup.
PlacementRequestDocument is created and added to database.
User redirected to Document list view.

workflows.name: Delete Document
steps: PlacementRequestDocument is deleted from database and file cleaned up.
User redirected to Document list view.

business_rules: Document type 'StudProf' (Student Profile) is omitted from dropdown of document types.
TypeCodeID is required; profile documents have magic number -1 if not uploaded.
Comments may be required depending on document type and 'Other' code validation.
Only editable screens allow edit and delete buttons.
UserSession and PRD_ID must be present for data operations.
validations: FileUpload requires a file to be present and not empty.
JavaScript variable 'ProfileMode' controls conditional validation for 'Other' comments.
calculations: FileSize is calculated from uploaded file.
Unique folder for file storage generated by GUID.
conditions: If document is in edit mode or exists, FormView is bound accordingly.
ProfileMode and OtherCodeID used for dynamic validation logic.
If updated details are empty, UI hides the respective panel.
system_behavior: Files are stored in new, unique folders to avoid collisions.
Old files are removed during updates to prevent orphaned files.
All UI controls are auto-generated; any changes must be made in code-behind.
Redirects are employed after save or delete to refresh the document list.
dependencies: Codes for document type options and validation.
Grid utility methods for UI control and value extraction.
exceptions: Invalid UserSession or missing PRD_ID: operation cancelled.
Magic number -1 for document type when no profile uploaded.
